sims.name: Liftoff
sims.tagline: The full-size FPV racing and freestyle sim. Real physics, real race tracks, and the closest thing to flying a 5-inch quad indoors.

sims.name: Liftoff: Micro Drones
sims.tagline: Tiny whoops in living rooms, offices and warehouses. Tight indoor courses that teach throttle control and precision at low speed.

sims.name: FPV.SkyDive
sims.tagline: Freestyle-focused proximity flying through mountains, bandos and big open terrain. Good for building confidence with speed and altitude.

sims.name: FPV Labs
sims.tagline: A sandbox drone simulator for experimenting with builds and tuning. Useful once a pilot wants to understand how setup changes affect handling.

sims.name: PicaSim
sims.tagline: Fixed-wing and glider training on real soaring slopes. The best starting point for stick discipline before moving to quads.
